card.name: Combination dosing with immunotherapy drugs
card.fires_on: Linking words such as "with", "or" and "receiving" right after "in combination" or a drug name in oncology dosing text, especially with immune checkpoint drugs. Also digits and dose-table words in the same sections.

modes.label: Combination linkers
modes.description: The word "with", "or" or "receiving" connecting a cancer drug to a partner drug or to patients.
modes.example: weeks for 13 cycles in combination with BCG induction and maintenance.
